verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents three provisioning paths. The console search page is the main portal for renting machines, and the REST API (OpenAPI spec confirmed by probe) and official CLI/SDK cover the full lifecycle: search, rent, wait for boot, connect. On-demand instances connect via SSH, Jupyter or a custom entrypoint, and the docs claim instances spin up in seconds with cached templates starting quickly; community users confirm it works for running jobs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on measurement of time-to-running-code, and evidence that startup speed holds across variable marketplace hosts (one user calls the stack a pain compared to AWS/GCP).
